text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills were unchanged from the last sale on March 12, a central bank statement said on Friday.
Three-month bills remained at 24.24 percent, six-month bills were unchanged at 30.15 percent, nine-month bills remained at 32.95 percent, and 12-month bills stayed at 35.60 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.00 million UAH 8.00 million UAH
Amount sold 8.00 million UAH 7.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.54 million UAH 7.54 million UAH
The central bank sold 80,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 14.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.00 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Amount sold 12.00 million UAH 11.94 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.43 million UAH 10.38 million UAH
The central bank sold 120,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 14.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 30.92 million UAH 26.23 million UAH
Actual amount raised 24.81 million UAH 21.04 million UAH
The central bank sold 309,197 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 14.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 37.00 million UAH 37.00 million UAH
Amount sold 37.00 million UAH 30.61 million UAH
Actual amount raised 27.31 million UAH 22.59 million UAH
The central bank sold 370,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 14.
